remarks: Now Available in the heart of Downtown Stamford: newly renovated spacious Studio with separate Sleeping Alcove that includes 1 Parking Space per tenant on lease. This bright and spacious Studio features New Kitchen & Bathroom Flooring, Refinished Hardwood Floors in the Living & Sleeping Areas. Fresh Paint throughout, New Bathroom Vanity & Medicine Cabinet. New Kitchen Countertops are being installed. Multiple windows provide lots of natural light, 3 generous closets and a defined Foyer creates true sense of entry. A Clean, Bright, Well Maintained Laundry Room is located on 1st Floor. Storage is available on a first come basis for $50 per month. On-Site Super. Rent includes heat, hot water, cooking gas and parking (see Documents for tenant parking instructions). Prime in-town location puts you steps away from restaurants, shopping and outdoor activities. Convenient to Public Transportation, Metro North train station, I95, and Merritt Parkway. No Pets Please. Strong financials required. Good Credit a MUST. $250 Move In/Move Out. Landlord to pull Credit Report. Unit will be professionally cleaned once renovations are complete.
